verdict.rationale: Evidence shows fraud-adjacent tooling (Real-Time Decisions for card authorization, 3DS support, Entity validation for compliance) but nowhere documents who bears financial liability for ACH return fraud, card disputes, or account takeover losses — no explicit liability-split or fraud-economics documentation is cited. Missing for 10: any documentation of liability allocation for ACH returns, card dispute chargebacks, or ATO losses between Increase, partner banks, and the platform customer.
